question: Where will the 2025 Para Athletics World Championships be held?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Delhi** has been chosen as the host city for the **2025 Para Athletics World Championships**.
 
• This is a significant achievement as it marks the **first time** India will host this prestigious global event for para-athletes.
 
• The championship is organized under the aegis of the **World Para Athletics (WPA)**, which is the governing body for para-athletics.
 
• It is a major international event where athletes with physical disabilities compete in various track and field events.
 
• Hosting such an event in India will not only highlight the country's **commitment to inclusivity** but also provide a platform for Indian para-athletes to showcase their talents.
 
• The selection of New Delhi demonstrates its capability in terms of **infrastructure, accessibility, and event management** for international sporting events.
 
• Such events can inspire and promote awareness about **disability sports** in India, encouraging more participation and support.
